steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals

steps.title: What FDA found at those plants

steps.finding: 22 inspections (1 OAI at our plants), 2 compliance actions, 0 import-alert listings, 0 recalls.

steps.title: What FDA wrote at the OAI inspections
steps.purpose: Read the Form 483 observations recorded at those inspections.

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

steps.title: What we decided last time
steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.
steps.finding: No past decisions on this drug.

sentences.text: FDA's records show amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; an earlier shortage was first posted on 2022-10-28 and has since been resolved.
The label for NDC 68071380701 names NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (FEI 3003294404) as a registered plant with a last inspection classified NAI on 2025-03-12.
FDA inspection 1114915 at NuCare Pharmaceuticals Inc (FEI 3003294404) ended 2020-01-10 and was classified VAI, 1022 days before the shortage posting on 2022-10-28.
A Warning Letter was issued to NuCare Pharmaceuticals Inc (FEI 3003294404) on 2019-09-27.
The label for NDC 76420081950 names ASCLEMED USA INC. DBA ENOVACHEM (FEI 3001452204) as a registered plant with a last inspection classified NAI on 2025-03-05.
FDA inspection 1067059 at Asclemed USA Inc. (FEI 3001452204) ended 2018-09-27 and was classified OAI.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and operates plants in Jordan (2INAMOXU24N-E and 2INAMOXU12N).
